Exact refusal inputs from a player's two Normal VR sessions on the published
GRID2VR 0.2.12 renderer (proxy 3c21a60f...a9c9), 2026-10-29, ProJict ba311920.
In both sessions using flashback stopped VR for the rest of the session.

Run 20261029-095744-252, frame 17027, eye pass 1: replay_camera_transition.
flashback-17027-entry-camera.bin / flashback-17027-complete-camera.bin: the
512-byte CameraContext at scene entry and at completion, from
replay-input-rejection.json. Entry near 0.0196 (0x3ca0a0a1, the mod's cockpit
camera) and far 2500 (0x451c4000); the native near-object pass completed at
.2/100 (0x3e4ccccd). Headset projection accepts stable clips only, and the
changed-clip path admits only .1/.2 entry near planes at far 15000, so the
guard correctly refuses either way.

Run 20261029-100504-919, frame 20918: eye_frustum_construction, then
visibility_not_ready. flashback-20918-volume/source/render/eyes.bin are the
saved visibility-failure-*.bin inputs (224/144/144/88 bytes, same layout as
brands-hatch-5834). The native render basis has Gram row 2 diagonal
.998305788 with off-diagonal radius .000333594, so its Gershgorin lower bound
.997972 is just below the .998 contraction limit; the basis guard correctly
refuses. Source and render views are byte-identical here.

Both refusals precede every game write. The fix keeps these guards unchanged
and cancels the pair into a suspended epoch instead of failing the session.
